## Design

### 2026-10-23 – Today I started brainstorming for the MIDI keyboard. The base parts that were used in the tutorial were really expensive and would be out of my budget since I'm in New Zealand, so I decided to switch

**5h**

Today I started brainstorming for the MIDI keyboard. The base parts that were used in the tutorial were really expensive and would be out of my budget since I'm in New Zealand, so I decided to switch up the components a bit.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/507ec9e0c40ae12493594f9fca38a6b6605e5a7f9c0b2ab4d5d435f49bed9259.png)
 This took a bit of searching to find parts that are cheap while also not using too many GPIOs. I ended up using all of them though, and this is what I have: a passive buzzer, 2 cherry MX switches, a rotary encoder, and 10 keys instead of 7.  This way it's more practical cuz there really isn't a need for 2 slide potentiometers when you have a rotary encoder. I changed the idea i was going for in this drawing slightly, removing the neo pixel.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/55d559a95b3362522ebd9e63b57b0a37ce82da43dd5310f1a324fd226c3c0cf6.png)
Then I made the schematic. I kept making mistakes and I had to go back and fix them but eventually i got to this. I wasn't used to using labels instead of wires, so I guess I learnt something there.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/7fdaa28838b01046559a356d6cae37007220c718e7233d798e95f45be28fca22.png)
Now I'm onto making my PCB, but I don't know how to make the piano keys properly with the gaps in between, which is a problem for another session.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/698f47c5bcb0a10c03ddfc8f8e81bcebd4f14dde87929ab31a39f10572dcff0d.png)
This is my PCB so far, it is pretty minimal but I do have to cut down of parts if I want more piano keys.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/33ed366f9bc9ca4533561ad0d78c7496c539ea4b7762dbd9d8aa840570b4f582.png)

### 2026-10-24 – This session, I completely finished my project. Here's a render of it:

**7h**

This session, I completely finished my project. Here's a render of it:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/c180d4f8caa1b1cb96f433bac5f550461c3591bd9cff93239317113e625add73.png)

I started off by making the PCB. Making the footprint for the piano was pretty time consuming. At first, I made it wrong and it was a polygon, then I had to go back and find a way to do it properly, then I had to do it again, and getting things to snap into place was suuper annoying, but I did it anyway. This is what i got:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/6416de66397ac3545f2a03b07292dbf12581b5b0cc102a7657c5de658afca07f.png)

Next, I had to route and make the PCB. This took the most amount of time, since my ESP32 was horizontal instead of vertical and the connections would block off other connections. Eventually though after a bunch of trial and error ad adjustments to my schematic, I got to this.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/5f08a2e4421678413e1cf1675c1838cd9506a77a55c0d6aa3733a4beb4349b38.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/38abfe4e2b272e9c7a4baae6248912714633520604f5c65d5abec22c134690fe.png)
This is what I had initially; I changed the layout a bit and made it easier to accommodate all the wiring
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/b08a102d53ac3eac0a6e257a8dfcfa0490248ecc50a9dff72bff8d42ce72f2e7.png)

Finally, I went parts hunting, and got a quote for the PCB. This didn't take too long as the parts were cheap and I didn't have many. I'm going to use a buzzer I already have to save money.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/529bcd70adac23f22e16801b106e963580e137f3913a44d96b8f00e3ff4fd80c.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/016ad3806e41268745d899b3f6b675e02d2296795f42c155b51a567314dfba06.png)

I did want to try and add designs but I don't really have any space left on the front, but that's all good. I might have to make some firmware, but if not, then I'm done.
